Radioactive Fog
Toxic Fog
Auditory hallucinations
Turns brief Hear All and local whisper or radio effects on or off. Shadow hallucinations are unchanged. Default: On.
Enabled
Turns Toxic Fog events on or off. Default: On.
Fog damage per hour
Health lost per in-game hour while exposed without working protection. Default: 180. Set to 0 to disable damage. Explicit values, including 120, are used as selected.
Fog mode
Scheduled events
Permanent
Scheduled events use the interval and duration settings below. Permanent keeps Toxic Fog active through rain, storms, snow, and other native weather. Default: Scheduled events.
Gas mask filter use rate
How quickly Toxic Fog uses gas mask filters. 0 stops filter use, 1 is the default rate, and 2 is twice as fast.
Hallucinations
Hallucinations through gas masks

Allows shadow-zombie hallucinations while a working gas mask, respirator, improvised mask, SCBA, or hazmat tank is worn in Toxic Fog. Breathing protection still blocks fog damage and auditory hallucinations. Changes apply live. Default: Off.
Master switch for shadow and sound hallucinations. Default: On.
Fixed respawn delay

Hound respawn wait, in in-game minutes, when Fixed interval is selected. Default: 60. Changes affect subsequent deaths, not waits already queued. Set to 0 to remove the gameplay delay; spawn grace, eligibility and release limits still apply.
Hound respawn mode
Progressive
Fixed interval
Progressive shortens the wait after each kill. Fixed interval always uses the setting below. Changes take effect after subsequent deaths; waits already queued keep their deadline.
Maximum event length
Longest length for future Scheduled events, from 1 to 24 in-game hours. No restart required. Default: 5. An event already running keeps its original length.
Maximum hounds

Maximum number of living hounds on the server. Each player can have at most one. Set to 0 for Toxic Fog without hounds; existing hounds are removed within about one real minute. Default: 64. Lowering a nonzero limit blocks new hounds until the population falls below it; it does not remove healthy existing hounds.
Maximum hounds at once
Maximum hounds released at once when several players are due. Default: 5. The allowance starts full and recovers one hound per in-game minute; it is also subject to the per-update release limit.
Maximum time between events

Longest wait between events, in in-game hours. Default: 72. Changing either interval restarts the wait from the current game time. Game time depends on day length, simulation speed and pauses; it does not advance while the server is stopped.
Minimum event length
Shortest length for future Scheduled events, from 1 to 24 in-game hours. No restart required. Default: 1. An event already running keeps its original length.
Minimum time between events

Shortest wait between events, in in-game hours. Default: 24. Changing either interval restarts the wait from the current game time. Game time depends on day length, simulation speed and pauses; it does not advance while the server is stopped.
Require sealed shelter
Off: any indoor room blocks the fog. On: outside walls must be intact and every exterior door and window closed. Default: Off.
Warning alarm

How many in-game minutes before a scheduled Toxic Fog event the distant eastern warning alarm sounds. Set to 0 to disable it. Changes apply live to the current scheduled event. Default: 60. When the Story Mode Warning System chapter is enabled, its objective sets this to 0 before activation and 60 afterward, and reapplies that value at server restart.
Warning alarm volume

Sets the loudness of the distant eastern warning alarm as a percentage. 100%% is normal volume; 200%% doubles it for the memes. Set to 0 to mute it. Changes apply to the next warning playback without restarting. Default: 50%%.
